description: Local 10-degree time-union simulation; no horizon/full-sky recovery claim.
mask_definition: Select coarse pixel centres within 5 degrees of zenith at any integration; retain all child pixels and point sources inside those coarse pixels.
row_order: time, frequency, baseline; positive then conjugate
signal_spectrum: Independent pixels/channels: P = sigma_21^2 times comoving voxel volume
gsm_history:
GSM2008 generated from scratch with pygdsm, downgraded to NSIDE=128, and transformed from Galactic to ICRS.  Read/written with pyradiosky version: 1.1.0.
FoV diameter 360.0 deg selected using the drift-scan union mask around central JD 2459999.097166265.
point_source_history:
GLEAM-like statistical catalogue generated from Franzen et al. source counts with seed 42.  Read/written with pyradiosky version: 1.1.0. Combined skymodels along the component axis using pyradiosky. Unique part of next object history follows.  Ten-source A-team model used by HERA validation-sim.
FoV diameter 360.0 deg selected using the union of 47 integrations from JD 2459999.0914398585 to 2459999.1028926712.
